articles.title: Fifth Third Stakes Claim in Texas with First Branch Opening
articles.mainIdea: Fifth Third Stakes Claim in Texas with First Branch Opening
articles.summary: Business Wire: Fifth Third Stakes Claim in Texas with First Branch Opening. CINCINNATI, April 22, 2026--Fifth Third (Nasdaq: FITB) today opened its first Texas financial center in Frisco, launching a broader expansion that builds on Comerica’s existing presence and represents more than $700 million in planned investment across the state. Following the conversion of Comerica branches on September 8, Fifth Third will operate 108 locations in Texas and plans to grow to more than 250 financial centers by 2029, securing a top‑five footprint in Dallas, Austin, and Houston. Related tickers mentioned: FITBM, FITBP.
